<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative crackdown:</strong> The Modi government has cleared a more stringent anti-paper leak bill, with plans to table the amendment in Parliament on Monday to address systemic examination integrity concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> BJP leaders have accused the INDIA bloc of obstructing parliamentary proceedings, while the Opposition continues to demand accountability and debate on critical issues like the NEET controversy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Diplomatic updates:</strong> The government informed the Lok Sabha that Prime Minister Modi raised the safety of Indian sailors during his recent high-level meeting with Donald Trump.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
</ul>
